purpose: Apply only the already-merged W1-A Organization Capability Authority Prisma migration after a read-only preflight has proven it is the sole pending repository migration in production.
requiredInvariants: Only migration 20260904120000_organization_capability_authority may be pending immediately before mutation; any other pending or unfinished repository migration fails closed.
The exact current-main migration image is immutable and its org.opencontainers.image.revision equals the target SHA.
A database backup or protected external backup evidence is mandatory before mutation.
The existing production API, web and Role Eligibility worker containers are not recreated or restarted.
Registration code and behavior are unchanged; the W1-A migration is additive and does not reference registration or Role Eligibility tables.
ROLE_ELIGIBILITY_ENFORCEMENT remains false before and after migration.
No capability assignment is backfilled or default-granted; both W1-A tables must contain zero rows immediately after migration.
The two W1-A tables must exist with ENABLE RLS and FORCE RLS after migration.
No tenant, organization, membership, user, registration or capability-assignment identifiers are emitted in evidence.
acceptance: Pre-mutation READ ONLY probe proves exactly one pending repository migration and it is the W1-A target.
Migration image command is exactly Prisma migrate deploy against prisma/schema.prisma and contains the target migration.
Backup evidence is persisted before mutation.
Prisma migrate deploy completes successfully exactly once.
Post-migration READ ONLY probe proves zero pending/unfinished repository migrations, target migration applied, both W1-A tables present with FORCE RLS and zero rows.
API/web runtime snapshot is identical before and after; Role Eligibility enforcement remains false.
Immutable evidence is uploaded and the result is written to issue #4997.
